sentence_quote: Tyere Brushett’s parole ineligibility is set at 13 years, that is, he must serve 13 years before he can apply for parole.
systemic_quote: but also considering the mitigating factor of his very challenging background as described in the IRCA, I agree with the Crown that the appropriate period for parole ineligibility is 13 years.
note: Parole ineligibility decision after jury verdict; life sentence automatic.

offence_note: Importing heroin and possession for trafficking
sentence_quote: On Count 2, importing heroin, I sentence you to four years' imprisonment. On Count 1, possession of heroin for the purpose of trafficking, I sentence you to three years' imprisonment.
note: Absence of profit motive treated as mitigating; concurrent sentences.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: I sentence you to serve a period of four years custody.
note: Other orders were granted earlier and are not shown.

offence_note: Sexual assault with weapon, assault causing bodily harm, theft, breach of probation
sentence_quote: The sentence is not demonstrably unfit and reflects no error in principle or disproportionate emphasis on any relevant factor.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine for trafficking; possession of proceeds of crime
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal. The fine in lieu of forfeiture provisions are not contrary to s. 12 of the Charter.
note: Crown appeal on fine in lieu of forfeiture; fine not yet decided; jail 3y 8m net not in issue.

offence_note: Driving while prohibited, breaches, other offences on five informations
sentence_quote: The appropriate sentences I have found in the absence of pre-sentence custody is a total sentence of 26.5 months incarceration, or 795 days in jail, to be followed by 12 months probation.
note: Not all seven offences are shown; co-accused sentenced separately; four driving prohibitions of unstated length.

offence_note: Offences not shown in the endorsement
sentence_quote: we do not feel that the interests of justice would be served by altering the sentence at this time.
note: Conditional sentence held unfit but left undisturbed given fresh evidence; length not shown.

offence_note: Dangerous driving causing death during epileptic seizure
sentence_quote: The appeal is allowed and the sentence of nine months will be served by way of a conditional sentence.
note: Two years less a day jail replaced by nine-month conditional sentence; 49 days credit deducted.

sentence_quote: We determined that a conditional sentence of two years less a day, followed by a three-year probation order, was a fit sentence in the circumstances of this case.
note: Addendum only; sentence appeal allowed earlier, original sentence not shown.
